title: Quickswitch: Ephemeral admin utilities catalog and dry-run surface
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a lightweight, discoverable catalog of ephemeral admin utilities (codename: Quickswitch) that on-call and first-line support can run as safe, auditable tasks. The feature combines: (1) a UI/CLI surface that lists curated utilities (shortflows) with typed inputs; (2) a sandboxed dry-run mode that simulates effects and surfaces safer remediate suggestions; (3) RBAC and approval gates for privileged steps; (4) integrated telemetry and post-run checklist prompts to capture run context for audits and follow-ups. Goal: reduce mean time to safe remediation for junior responders while preserving guardrails for production-sensitive actions.
comments: 2026-02-11 — Kickoff sync: scoped MVP to 8 shortflows (eg. restart worker, rotate keys cache, clear model cache). Agreed to prioritize flows that have non-destructive dry-run semantics.
2026-02-17 — Design pass with UX: added 'confidence' and 'impact' badges per shortflow; will surface example outputs in dry-run. Action: DES to provide mockups by 2026-02-23.

2026-02-24 — Security review request filed. Security note: privileged steps must require two-step approval when targeting prod; can run single-step in staging. See attachments for submitted SR ticket.
2026-03-02 — Eng prototyping: built a PoC CLI that executes dry-run locally and emits a structured log event with context_id and intent markers. Telemetry schema proposal attached.
2026-03-05 — PM feedback: require a 'revert plan' field on any shortflow that mutates state. Added to acceptance criteria.
2026-03-09 — Pair review: Miguel and Li validated audit trail capture to internal dashboard; noted performance impact on runtime logging — plan to sample at 1% for low-risk flows.

2026-03-12 — Blocker discovered: existing admin-runner cannot simulate KV-cache eviction safely in dry-run. Decision: implement a simulated backend adapter for a subset of ops; tracked as dependency ENG-741259.
